name: reasoning-services
description: 10 reasoning engines + 12 skills for structured thinking. Isolated MCP sessions that don't pollute context or reinforce biases. Decision matrices, multi-perspective analysis, thought graphs, adversarial review, deterministic logic proofs, hindsight-bias correction, and reflection — with auto-triggering skills that teach Claude when and how to use each engine.
